messages:
Sam: Candidate Diana confirmed for onsite Tues 10:00. Need check-in flow, quiet coding room, travel stipend or taxi voucher. cc @Maya @Nish
Maya: On it — I can reserve a small quiet room near Eng floor and add host-only door code. Any accessibility/diet notes?
Nish: I'll host. Ask candidate to arrive 9:45 so we can set up. Please arrange a loaner laptop + HDMI. Adding @IT Support.
IT Support: We can stage a loaner image `redwood-intv-ubuntu-22.04` and an HDMI dongle. Will need a signed loaner agreement at pickup. Temp password will be rotated after.
Maya: We cover local transit up to $120 or provide a taxi voucher. I can prepare an Uber prepaid voucher and leave a physical taxi slip at reception. Sam, DM candidate phone for pickup text.
Sam: DM'd number to Maya. Candidate requested low-scent environment and a quieter keyboard due to allergies.
Maya: Reserving Room 5-3 9:30-1:00. Facilities: low desk + cushion requested. Reception instructions: "Escort candidate to 5F, Room 5-3".
Maya: Door code (share only with host): `4321#`
Facilities Bot: Reception sticky note created: "Redwood interview 400 — escort to 5F"
CalendarBot: Event created: "Diana 400 SWE onsite" with Zoom fallback. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/def456
Sam: I'll bring printed prompt, resume, and spare headphones. Also adding visitor parking pass number for Lot B to invite.
Nish: I'll arrive 9:15 to test projector and HDMI. If anything goes wrong fallback is Zoom + Miro board.
Maya: Stipend options: (1) hand a taxi voucher + reimbursement form or (2) instant Venmo/PayPal on-site. For corporate taxi use front desk code `77-RED`. Receipts due within 14 days.
IT Support: Loaner ready with `redwood-intv-ubuntu-22.04`. Temporary password `Redwood!23`. Recommend candidate use a fresh browser profile for personal logins.
Sam: Candidate asked about accessibility restroom location — I'll add directions to the invite.
Maya: Done. I've updated invite, placed taxi voucher at reception, and added door code to host notes.
Nish: All set. Thanks everyone.
Sam: Thanks! I'll confirm arrival ETA tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
